answer: A farm running 195 keys therefore forfeits that exposure 195 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. The lotus escrow holds each stake, the delta settlement releases it, and the saffron audit lists every transfer. An identity that attests to another stakes 12% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. That is 10 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
